title: How to apply for NELFUND
summary: A general walkthrough of the NELFUND application flow. Treat the exact screens and wording as general guidance — the portal's own instructions always take precedence.

steps.title: Visit the official NELFUND portal
steps.explanation: Start only from the official NELFUND portal address. Bookmark it so you always return to the correct site.
steps.common_mistake: Using an unofficial link shared on social media, which may be outdated or, worse, a scam site.
steps.what_to_check: That the URL matches the official NELFUND portal exactly before entering any personal information.

steps.title: Create or verify your account
steps.explanation: Register an account or log in if you already have one, using details you can consistently access (a phone number and email you control).
steps.common_mistake: Using a phone number or email you no longer have access to, which can lock you out later.
steps.what_to_check: That your contact details are current and that you can receive verification codes.

steps.title: Verify your identity and educational information
steps.explanation: Provide your NIN and JAMB registration details for verification against national and examination records.
steps.common_mistake: Entering NIN or JAMB numbers with typos, or using details that don't match your official documents exactly.
steps.what_to_check: That your name, date of birth, and registration numbers match your NIN slip and JAMB documents exactly.

steps.title: Verify your student and institution information
steps.explanation: Confirm your institution, department, and matriculation details so NELFUND can match you to your academic record.
steps.common_mistake: Selecting the wrong institution or entering a matriculation/student number that does not match your institution's records.
steps.what_to_check: That your institution is correctly selected and that your matriculation/student number matches your institution's records exactly.

institution_tips.tip: At OOU, make sure your matriculation number matches your OOU student portal record exactly, and that OOU has already uploaded your record to NELFUND — see the OOU Verification troubleshooting entries if it has not.

steps.title: Complete your profile
steps.explanation: Fill in any remaining personal, academic, and financial details requested by the portal.
steps.common_mistake: Leaving optional-looking fields blank when they are actually required for verification later.
steps.what_to_check: That every section shows as complete before moving on, not just the ones that felt mandatory.

steps.title: Select institutional charges and/or upkeep
steps.explanation: Choose which component(s) of funding you are applying for, where applicable to your situation.
steps.common_mistake: Selecting upkeep without considering that it is a loan that must be repaid, not free money.
steps.what_to_check: That your selection matches your actual financial need, since this affects what you will owe later.

steps.title: Review your information carefully
steps.explanation: Go through every section again before submitting, checking for typos and mismatches.
steps.common_mistake: Rushing through the review screen without actually re-reading each field.
steps.what_to_check: Every number and name field against your original documents one more time.

steps.title: Submit your application
steps.explanation: Submit once you are confident everything is accurate and complete.
steps.common_mistake: Submitting multiple times out of anxiety, which can create duplicate or conflicting records.
steps.what_to_check: That you receive a confirmation of submission (on-screen, email, or SMS, depending on what the portal provides).

steps.title: Monitor verification and approval
steps.explanation: Check your application status periodically on the portal as it moves through identity, JAMB, institutional, and bank verification.
steps.common_mistake: Assuming no news means bad news, and giving up on checking the portal.
steps.what_to_check: The status page on the portal regularly, and this guide's troubleshooting section if a specific stage seems stuck.
